item.title: Women’s Day 2026 campaigns spotlight the realities behind empowerment
item.description: Every year, brands mark International Women’s Day with campaigns that attempt to reflect the realities of women’s lives, often moving beyond celebration to conversations that feel more honest and grounded. item.title: Cherish Nair joins Zee Live as Brand and Marketing Consultant
item.description: Cherish Nair has joined Zee Live as Brand and Marketing Consultant. She announced the move through a LinkedIn post, marking a new chapter after nearly two years at creative agency Moonshot. In her new role, Nair will work on shaping brand narratives and building stronger audience engagement for large-scale cultural and entertainment experiences produced by Zee Live. item.title: Govt of Karnataka considers social media ban for children under 16
item.description: The government of Karnataka has proposed a ban on the use of social media for children under the age of 16. The announcement was made by Chief Minister Siddaramaiah while presenting the state’s annual budget. Siddaramaiah said the move aims to address concerns around the increasing use of mobile phones by children and the possible negative effects of unrestricted digital access. item.title: Why maternity policies alone can’t fix A&M’s attrition problem
item.description: A few days ago, I heard a story that felt strangely out of place in 2026. A friend of mine, an HR professional herself, had been preparing to return to work after her maternity leave. A day before her joining date, she received the call that her position had been eliminated. item.title: Why Women’s History Month belongs in your content calendar
item.description: Nine out of ten women say advertisers do not understand them. According to 2024 data from NielsenIQ, 91% of women felt that the brands selling to them have not made the effort to actually understand who they are, what they need, or how they live. They do not feel seen. They do not feel spoken to. They feel, at best, like an afterthought. Which is strange. Because brands do make the effort. item.description: At many workplaces, International Women’s Day begins with familiar gestures. item.title: What if 'Women's Day' didn't exist?
item.description: When I started brainstorming this question, a slightly unsettling thought surfaced: if International Women's Day didn't exist on the calendar, would we - as an industry - simply forget about the 50% of the population that makes the world go round? item.title: X tests new ad format adding product links in user posts
item.description: X is testing a new advertising format that links ads to product mentions within user posts. item.title: X introduces audio feature for long-form articles powered by Grok
item.description: X has introduced a feature that allows users to listen to long-form articles posted on the platform using audio generated by Grok. The feature adds a ‘Listen’ button to long-form articles when they appear in users’ feeds. When activated, the tool converts the text into audio, allowing users to hear the content instead of reading it.
